scope: Fourth batch Area3 only: preserve actual receipt/parser resource exhaustion, distinguish inaccessible bytes from demonstrably malformed bytes, and retain integrity/resource primary failures across secondary cell cleanup or persistence errors.

finite_cases.case: update_receipt propagates the original MemoryError injected at receipt read, and original MemoryError, ResourceExceeded or RecursionError injected at parsing, without replacing committed bytes or inventing a corruption sidecar; a read PermissionError remains infrastructure

Fixed genuinely malformed JSON, duplicate-key JSON, invalid UTF-8 and non-object committed bytes produce integrity failure and preserve original bytes; injected MemoryError or PermissionError during the independent failure-sidecar write remains secondary to that corruption

Finite direct error_record cases keep MemoryError, ResourceExceeded, RecursionError and each of three literal module-specific resource types resource_incomplete in preflight and measurement; initial wrong-runtime/source IntegrityError remains execution_blocked, while observed integrity drift remains integrity_invalid

Direct run_cell with MemoryError injected during runtime preflight plus a later receipt PermissionError retains the original resource failure in a reserved sidecar; zero imports, fixtures, entries and returns

Direct run_cell with three fixed pre-call source-check/terminal-accounting fault pairs: primary resource then later I/O, primary I/O then later resource, and primary integrity then later resource. Preserve or promote only the appropriate typed primary with all other errors secondary and zero method calls

data_policy: All variants are explicit literal bytes and unittest.mock fault instances. Four run_cell invocations use only the existing fabricated module/fixture seams; the evaluator methods must never be entered. No generated/fuzzed inputs, real timer, historical import, measurement fixture, scientific body, protocol, resource cap or runtime pin changes. Existing C01-C15 plans, prior 145-test receipts and snapshots remain unchanged.
test_execution: This worker writes the prospective plan and repairs and performs static AST/JSON checks only; the parent runs the separately authorized combined suite.
